facts.fact: Loi 24-08 of 24 November 2024 (Finance Law 2025) grants startups and incubators a transfer-duty exemption and extends incubators' IRG/IBS exemptions by two years, per Deloitte Société d'Avocats.
Finance Law 2025 exempts registration duties on company-formation deeds for holders of the 'projets innovants' label, per Deloitte Société d'Avocats.
